Certificate dependency notices

These notices cover the certificate dependencies added to Domus Obscura.
Cargo.lock identifies the resolved versions and all transitive dependencies.
This file is not a complete notice list for the application.

Include this directory and ../file-id-0.2.3/LICENSE-APACHE when distributing
a binary that includes these dependencies. Keep the existing file-id notices.
The Notify attribution in that Apache license file applies to file-id only.
No dependency source code has been modified.
